meta.name: create-goal
meta.description: Create a Mission, Project, or Goal (Mission → Project → Goal → Task hierarchy) in EvoNexus. Guides the user through picking a mission, choosing or creating a project, defining a measurable goal with metric_type and target_value. Writes to the SQLite goals tables via POST /api/goals. Use when the user says 'create a goal', 'add a mission', 'set a target', 'measure X', 'track Y towards Z', or wants to link work to a measurable outcome.

copy.tagline: 在 EvoNexus 中创建任务层级并关联可量化目标
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果使用 EvoNexus 管理项目并需要将任务与可衡量目标关联。
copy.tagline_en: Create mission-project-goal hierarchy with measurable targets in EvoNexus
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use EvoNexus to manage projects and need to link tasks to measurable outcomes.

howto.what: 当你想创建目标时，Claude会引导你选择使命(mission)、项目(project)，再定义可衡量的目标(goal)，包括度量类型(如计数、金额)和目标值，最后自动将目标写入EvoNexus数据库。
howto.when: 当你说“create a goal”、“add a mission”、“set a target”等关键词，或想要关联可衡量结果时触发。

say.text: 帮我创建目标：3个月内获得100个付费客户
say.note: 引导选择项目和度量类型

say.text: 为'Evo AI'项目添加目标：达到50k MRR
设定一个布尔型目标：完成账单系统v2

howto.what_en: After installing, Claude can guide you through creating a goal in the Mission → Project → Goal hierarchy, collecting details like metric type and target value, and writes it to the database via API.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say 'create a goal', 'add a mission', 'set a target', or want to link work to a measurable outcome.

say_en.text: Help me create a goal: 100 paying customers in 3 months.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you to pick a project and metric type.

say_en.text: Add a goal for 'Evo AI' project: reach $50k MRR.
Set a boolean goal: ship billing v2.
